description: Ligand discovery and binding-site analysis across the PDB. mode "find_ligand" resolves a name or formula to chemical component IDs with metadata (formula, weight, SMILES), ranked by deposition frequency — most-deposited component first, so the top hit is the most common match for the name, not necessarily an exact name-string match. The ranking covers a bounded candidate pool; totalCount and candidatesConsidered report how many components matched and how many were ranked. mode "structures_with_ligand" returns PDB entries holding a bound copy of a ligand (by exact component ID — get the ID from find_ligand first), highest-resolution first, each with its resolution in Å, title, method, and the polymer entities whose chains carry the ligand. This mode and find_ligand's depositionCount count bound copies only: a component present only as a residue inside a polymer chain (e.g. MSE in a selenomethionine protein) or a sugar inside a branched glycan is not counted. mode "binding_site" returns the protein residues lining a ligand's pocket in a given structure, with contact distances, each numbered in both the mmCIF label namespace (asymId, seqId) and the author namespace (authAsymId, authSeqId) used by deposited coordinates and most literature. Binding sites are experimental-only (computed from deposited coordinates; predicted models carry no bound ligands).

comp_id.description: Exact chemical component ID (modes structures_with_ligand and binding_site).

mode.description: Operation: resolve a ligand, find structures containing it, or analyze its binding site.

start.description: Zero-based result offset (modes structures_with_ligand and binding_site; binding_site pages ligand instances).

name: protein_track_ligands

bindingSites.description: Ligand instances and their pocket residues (binding_site), in a fixed order — ligands by entity number, then the instances of each ligand by author chain and author residue number — so start/limit pages read every instance exactly once.

items.description: A ligand instance and the protein residues lining its pocket.

ligandAsymId.description: Author chain ID (auth_asym_id) of the ligand instance — the author namespace, unlike residues[].asymId.

ligandAuthSeqId.description: Author residue number (auth_seq_id) of the ligand instance.

residues.description: Protein residues lining the pocket, nearest first.

items.description: A pocket residue in contact with the ligand, in both numbering namespaces.

asymId.description: mmCIF label_asym_id of the residue's chain (label namespace, paired with seqId). Can differ from authAsymId.

authAsymId.description: Author chain ID (auth_asym_id) of the residue's chain, as deposited and as most structure viewers label it.

authSeqId.description: Author residue number (auth_seq_id), as deposited and as most literature and viewers number it. Related to seqId by no fixed offset; insertion codes are not reported.

distance.description: Contact distance to the ligand in Å.

seqId.description: mmCIF label_seq_id: position in the entity sequence (label namespace). Not the deposited residue number; see authSeqId.

candidatesConsidered.description: Chemical components pulled into the deposition-frequency ranking (find_ligand). Below totalCount when the candidate pool was truncated; the ranking then covers only these candidates.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_param`: The mode-specific required input is absent: query (find_ligand), comp_id (structures_with_ligand), or pdb_id (binding_site). `not_found`: No chemical component matched the name/formula, or the structure has no instance of the ligand. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A resolved chemical component (ligand) and its identifiers.

depositionCount.description: Number of PDB entries holding a bound (non-polymer) copy of this component — the totalCount structures_with_ligand reports for it. Entries where it occurs only as a residue inside a polymer chain or a sugar inside a branched glycan are not counted. Candidates are ranked by this value, most-deposited first.

nextStart.description: Offset for the next structures_with_ligand or binding_site page; absent on the final or past-end page.

notice.description: Advisory note: a find_ligand candidate pool smaller than the upstream match count, a structures_with_ligand page that is empty because no entry contains the component or because start is past the end, or a binding_site page that leaves instances for a later start or starts past the last instance.

resolvedCompId.description: The chemical component ID used to query.

start.description: Zero-based offset of the structures_with_ligand or binding_site result page.

structures.description: PDB entries holding a bound (non-polymer) copy of the ligand, highest-resolution first (structures_with_ligand).

items.description: A PDB entry holding a bound copy of the ligand: its resolution, title, method, and host entities.

hostEntities.description: Polymer entities whose author chains carry an instance of the ligand, in entity-number order. The chain assignment is the depositor's, so a ligand at a subunit interface lists only its assigned chain's entity — use mode binding_site for the residues it contacts. Omitted when no polymer chain carries an instance.

items.description: A polymer entity carrying an instance of the ligand.

organisms.description: Distinct source organisms of the entity. Omitted when upstream names none.

id.description: PDB entry ID holding a bound copy of the ligand.

method.description: Experimental method(s), comma-joined. Omitted when unreported.

resolution.description: Best reported resolution in Å (absent for methods without one, e.g. NMR).

totalCount.description: Total upstream matches before any local narrowing: PDB entries holding a bound (non-polymer) copy of the component (structures_with_ligand), chemical components matching the query (find_ligand), or ligand instances with pocket contacts (binding_site).

title: protein-mcp-server: track ligands
